title: Agent onboarding accepts minimal manifest and completes HELLO→ACT without provider credentials
preconditions: Valid agent token is issued for owner_id user.local
No model-provider API keys are configured

steps.notes: Compatible HELLO selects agent-protocol/v1
Valid token accepted
Valid minimal manifest accepted without model/runtime/memory fields
First OBSERVE returns schema-valid Chamber observation
First ACT produces expected ledger event(s)
Unsupported protocol rejected
Invalid token rejected
Manifest missing required identity fields rejected
Duplicate registration is idempotent or explicitly versioned
GET displays approval context but issues no credential and performs no approval
Same-origin authenticated approval issues a distinct Controller credential bound to the pending Account and Player
Consumed enrollment fails closed and issues no second credential
Default bootstrap requesting administrative scope is rejected
Bootstrap attempting to inherit the operator session is rejected
Expired enrollment fails closed and issues no credential
Replacement invalidates the prior enrollment
Each binding mismatch fails closed against the server-side pending record
Denial invalidates enrollment and issues no credential
Skill installation without explicit operator approval is rejected
Direct protocol client completes onboarding without a skill
Malformed skill integrity identifier is rejected

assertions: Invalid token rejected with FORBIDDEN or equivalent auth error
Duplicate registration is idempotent or explicitly versioned without double budget charge
First OBSERVE returns schema-valid Chamber observation
First ACT produces expected ledger event(s)
Provider API key is not required for external agent connection
Private prompt disclosure is not required
Advanced fields (model, memory_system, subagent_architecture) are not required for minimal REGISTER
Email link retrieval alone cannot approve enrollment or issue a credential
Optional skill installation requires operator approval and an isolated game-only profile
A direct protocol client can onboard without installing a skill
Available actions are derived from observations without dynamically generated verbs
Bootstrap bindings match the server-side Account, Player, world, origin, and pending enrollment
Administrative scope, operator-session inheritance, and malformed integrity fixtures are rejected
Expired, replaced, denied, replayed, and wrong-binding enrollment attempts issue no credential
Optional skill installation is denied without explicit operator approval
Direct protocol onboarding succeeds without a skill
